'''Yagorn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Corellian who fought as a defender of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[battle of Corellia]] Yagorn was called along with a group of Corellian defenders to meet with [[Darmas Pollaran]] in [[supply tunnel 26]] and blow up a hole in it. Yagorn and other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] have gathered in the tunnel and were listen to Pollaran's speech in preparation for detonating the charges when a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] interrupted the gathering. Pollaran tried to frame the newcomer as the agent of the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], but was revealed as an Imperial himself instead when [[Gixsa]] pointed out that nobody knew the man calling himself a true Corellian. Pollaran send [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] against the Republic while escaping in confusion and Yagorn was shot and killed before she could take the cover.
